info.title: Integrated Strategy System API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code` and a translatable `messageKey`.

AccessMeDto.description: What the signed-in user can open and do; the UI uses it to show menus and actions (the server still checks).

ActInput.description: A decision on a task (API body).

AiDataSharing.description: What may be sent to the provider: per system and fields, documents, and masking of personal data.

AiFeatureSettings.description: Per feature: switch, provider and model (else the default provider and its default model).

AiFormField.description: A form field the AI may propose a value for.

AiLimits.description: Monthly limits (null = none), counted in the installation's time zone.

AiOcrSettings.description:
Text recognition (OCR) for scanned PDF pages and images (ADR 0033): off by default; Tesseract language codes joined by `+`; at most
`MaxPages` scanned pages per document.

AiProviderInput.description: A provider to save. `ApiKey` null keeps the stored key; `ClearApiKey` removes it.

AiProviderProbeInput.description: Values to try before saving (all optional: the stored ones are used).

AiSettings.description: Settings → AI (docs/design/ai.md §3). Master switch off on a new installation: everything works without AI.

AiSettingsDto.description: Settings → AI. `OcrAvailable`: Tesseract and the configured languages are installed on the server (ADR 0033).

AntiforgeryToken.description: The token the SPA sends back in string AntiforgerySetup.HeaderName on every state-changing call.

ApprovalSettings.description: Settings → Approvals: which organisation levels the "section manager" and "department director" rules look for (ADR 0025).

ApprovalStepDefinition.description: One step of a chain, as configured in the Approval Settings centre.

ApproverBriefDto.description: An approver brief: the AI paragraph and points (drafts), plus the changes computed from the audit trail (facts).

ApproverRule.description:
Who approves a step. Only the parameters of string ApproverRule.Kind are used: `role` → string? ApproverRule.RoleKey; `sectionManager`,
`departmentDirector` → string? ApproverRule.Of; `headOfUnit` → Guid? ApproverRule.UnitId or string? ApproverRule.Of; `owningUnit` →
string? ApproverRule.SystemCode (default: the process's system); `employee` → Guid? ApproverRule.EmployeeId; `recordRole` / `teamRole`
→ string? ApproverRule.RoleCode.

AuditEntryDto.description: An entry as shown on History tabs and the Audit Log.

BilingualText.description: A value in both languages (status message parameters).

BrandingSettings.description: Branding per installation (SPEC §0.2): names, colour, email header / footer. Logos are separate assets.

BusinessHoursReference.description: A business-hours record as other components see it.

CardValues.description: Everything an author sets on a card (form / API / AI builder).

ChecklistItem.description: A verification checklist item (SPEC K4.3, ADR 0064).

CreatedAccessTokenDto.description: The new token: string CreatedAccessTokenDto.Token is shown once and never stored.

CreateTask.description:
New Task (SPEC §11.7): one or many assignees (and / or every employee of a unit) → one task per assignee, tied by an assignment group
when there are several (SPEC §11.4).

CriterionLevel.description: One level of a team criterion. `Min` / `Max`: data range for a data-backed criterion (Min inclusive, Max inclusive; null = open).

CriterionResult.description: The evaluator's choice for one criterion, with the system's suggestion and its basis.

CurrentStatus.description:
"Next action required + who" (SPEC §0.2) for one record: a translatable message with parameters, who acts, and the actions the
current user may take now.

CurrentStatusAction.description: A next action offered on the current-status banner (code handled by the record page).

CustomApprovalAction.description: A labelled extra button, e.g. "Approve with conditions" (outcome approve).

DataElement.description: A data element of a composite KPI (e.g. numerator / denominator).

EmployeeRefDto.description: A short reference to an employee shown next to units, managers and delegations.

EnrolmentResultDto.description: Result of a completed MFA enrolment: signed in, plus the recovery codes to show once.

EvaluationStatusDto.description: An evaluation as a person without the results permission sees it: status only.

ExtractedFieldDto.description:
One proposed value: never saved by the server; the review UI shows it as a draft (docs/design/ai.md §4.1). Where the source was found:
`LocationKind``page` / `slide` / `image` with its number, and `FromScan` when the text came from OCR (ADR 0033).

FieldError.description: A validation failure on one field.

FilesSettings.description: Settings → Files: global upload limit and the optional ClamAV scan (SPEC §0.2 "size / type limits, virus-scan hook").

ImportIssue.description: One problem found in an uploaded file. int ImportIssue.Row is the sheet row number; string? ImportIssue.Column a column key.

missedIncludesAmber.description: Publish `KpiTargetMissed` for amber results too (red always).

LinksToDto.description: Links pointing at a record: the visible ones resolved, the others only counted.

LinkView.description: A resolved link as the UI shows it. Only string LinkVisibility.Visible views carry content.

McpSettings.description: Settings → MCP (docs/design/mcp.md §4). The server is off on a new installation.

McpToolSettings.description: Per tool: null keeps the tool's default (read on, write and approve off).

MeasuringMethodRule.description: A Measuring Method code mapped to its aggregation rule (SPEC K5).

MyWorkItem.description: An item that needs the user's action, shown on My Work.

OrgTreeNodeDto.description: A node of the organisation tree (flat list; the client builds the tree from Guid? OrgTreeNodeDto.ParentId).

PagedResultOfAiUsageRowDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfAuditEntryDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfAuthEventDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfDeliveryDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfEmployeeListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfKpiCardListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfProjectListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfRequestListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfSampleItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfTaskListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfTeamListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfUserDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PortfolioOptionsDto.description: Everything the request screens need to render choices and live calculations (labels are configuration).

PortfolioSettings.description: Settings → Portfolio (docs/design/portfolio.md §2.1). Defaults are SPEC Appendix A (Q-P5, Q-P6).

PriorityBand.description: A priority band: the highest band whose minimum (ratio, 1.0 = 100 %) is at or below the score applies.

PriorityCriterion.description: A prioritisation criterion (SPEC §1.12 configurable weighted scoring; defaults are the four ADoF criteria).

ProposedChange.description: What a definition change proposes (null = unchanged).

ProviderField.description: One setting of a provider type. Labels come from the UI translations (`admin:providers.fields.<key>`).

ProviderTypeSchema.description: Settings form of a provider type: its fields, whether it has a secret, and whether the secret is required.

ReassignEmployeeTasks.description:
"Reassign open tasks of an employee" (ADR 0040). `TaskIds` narrows the preview (null = all open tasks). In `to-creators` mode the
tasks the leaver created themself need `FallbackEmployeeId`, who receives them.

ReassignmentTaskDto.description: One open task of the leaving employee. Titles are left out for tasks the administrator may not read (confidential).

RecordSearchHit.description: A record found by search or similarity, already filtered to what the user may read.

RecordSnapshotDto.description: Field values of a record at a point in time, rebuilt from its create snapshot and later field updates.

RegionalSettings.description: Regional settings (SPEC §0, §0.2 localisation). Hijri display is off by default.

RequestCapabilities.description: What the current user may do on the request now (drives the record page; the server checks again on every call).

RequestFileDto.description: A file on a request with its kind (`document`, `cost-estimation`, `project-scope`, `quotation`).

unitId.description: Requesting unit (department or section); defaults to the requester's unit.

costPath.description: CostPaths: whether a cost estimation file is available or the project scope goes to Administration.

RequestValues.description:
Every editable value of a Program Request (SPEC §1.4 A, docs/design/portfolio.md §3.1). Used by the wizard (create / update), the rules
and the calculators. Amounts are in the installation currency, two decimals; ratios are 0–1.

RewardCell.description: One cell of the reward matrix: grade × workload × member role → amount.

SampleEditorDto.description: An employee holding the item's "editor" record role.

ScaleLevel.description: A level of a qualitative KPI's scale.

SignInOutcome.description: Outcome of a sign-in step. IReadOnlyList<string> SignInOutcome.Methods lists the second factors the user may use (or enrol).

SmartCheck.description: One check of the SMART quality review of a KPI card (SPEC §2.9 KPI card builder).

SmtpSettingsInput.description: SMTP form. A blank string? SmtpSettingsInput.Password keeps the stored one; bool SmtpSettingsInput.ClearPassword removes it.

SuggestionBasis.description: The data behind a suggested level: e.g. 12 of 13 closed = 92.31 %, or 30 h average over 6 meetings.

TargetReason.description: A target proposal with the reasons behind it (message keys with parameters).

TaskCapabilitiesDto.description: What the current user may do on the task besides the transitions in IReadOnlyList<string> TaskDto.Actions.

TaskSettings.description: Settings → Tasks (docs/design/tasks.md §2). Defaults are the SPEC / Appendix A build defaults; nothing organisation-specific in code.

TeamOptionsDto.description: What the formation wizard and team pages need (any signed-in user): active types and roles, the published template's grades.

TeamSettings.description: Settings → Teams, general area (docs/design/teams.md §2). Types, roles, templates and matrices are tables (ADR 0041).

TemplateContent.description: The content of an evaluation template version (stored as JSON).
